defmodule CartPricing.Sales.CartItem do
  @moduledoc false

  use Ash.Resource,
    data_layer: Ash.DataLayer.Ets,
    domain: CartPricing.Sales

  ets do
    private?(false)
    table(:sales_cart_item)
  end

  resource do
    description("An individual item within a shopping cart.")
  end

  actions do
    default_api Ash.Api.default_api_for(CartPricing.Sales)

    create :create do
      argument :cart_id, :uuid, allow_nil?: false
      argument :sku, :string, allow_nil?: false
      argument :unit_price_cents, :integer, allow_nil?: false
      argument :quantity, :integer, allow_nil?: false

      validate fn changeset, _context ->
        qty = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :quantity) || Ash.Changeset.get_attribute(changeset, :quantity)

        cond do
          is_integer(qty) and qty >= 1 -> :ok
          true -> {:error, field: :quantity, message: "must be at least 1"}
        end
      end

      change set_attribute(:sku, arg(:sku))
      change set_attribute(:unit_price_cents, arg(:unit_price_cents))
      change set_attribute(:quantity, arg(:quantity))
      change relate_actor(:cart, arg(:cart_id))
    end

    read :read do
      primary? true
    end

    get :by_id, :id
  end

  attributes do
    attribute :id, :uuid do
      primary_key? true
      default fn -> Ash.UUID.generate() end
    end

    attribute :sku, :string do
      allow_nil? false
    end

    attribute :unit_price_cents, :integer do
      allow_nil? false
    end

    attribute :quantity, :integer do
      allow_nil? false
    end
  end

  relationships do
    belongs_to :cart, CartPricing.Sales.Cart do
      attribute_write_requires_read? false
      allow_nil? false
      attribute_read_requires_read? false
    end
  end

  calculations do
    calculate :line_total_cents, :integer, expr(unit_price_cents * quantity), public?: true

    calculate :tier_discount_bps, :integer,
      expr(
        cond do
          quantity >= 25 -> 1500
          quantity >= 10 -> 1000
          quantity >= 5 -> 500
          true -> 0
        end
      ),
      public?: true

    calculate :discounted_line_total_cents, :integer, CartPricing.Sales.Calculations.DiscountedLineTotal, public?: true
  end

  code_interface do
    domain CartPricing.Sales
  end
end
